Nuvon Residency was my stay for four days, and overall it was a good experience. The team was really supportive and courteous throughout our stay.

The rooms were clean, and since it’s a relatively new property, everything felt fresh. However, we did have to remind the staff daily for room cleaning, which could be improved.

We had a bulk booking, and the coordination was handled well. Although there is no in-house restaurant yet, they serve a tasty breakfast in the common area, which was well managed and satisfying.

I would definitely recommend this place for anyone travelling to Delhi and looking for an approachable, clean, and cost-effective stay. Overall, a good and comfortable option.

I had a wonderful stay at nivon residency. The hotel was very clean and nice staff . Everything is fresh and comfortable.overall it's a perfect choice for anyone looking pleasant, comfortable, budget  friendly stay. Highly recommend.
Small rooms but fairly well- maintained. Strong Wi-Fi network with a minimal breakfast offered as part of the package.
